brief:
Former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot said Israel cannot hold fair elections while Benjamin Netanyahu remains in the race, the Ma'an news agency reported. Eisenkot, who previously served as chief of staff of the Israeli military, did not elaborate on the specific concerns underlying his assertion.

The statement adds to mounting criticism of Netanyahu from prominent Israeli figures ahead of upcoming electoral proceedings.

media.credit: Gadi Eisenkot — Wikimedia Commons / Spokesperson unit, President of Israel

title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu's presence will taint Israeli elections
